newsitem.title: FRANCE: French policy consistent with European goals - Aubry.
newsitem.headline: French policy consistent with European goals - Aubry.

text.p: The new French government's policies, outlined by Prime Minister Lionel Jospin on Thursday, are consistent with France's European objectives, Employment and Social Security minister Martine Aubry said on Friday.

Asked in an interview with RTL radio whether the policies contradicted the government's European objectives, she said "The fiscal and social reform will indeed allow the country to stay on track...while implementing the policies announced, that is, not stopping households from spending, helping the weakest, creating solidarity and we are also helping companies in need, I'm thinking about construction (companies) and small and medium-sized companies," Aubry said.
Aubry was speaking the day after Socialist Prime Minister Lionel Jospin outlined to parliament his broad policy objectives.
